calls.statement:
SELECT 
    SUM(frl.quantity_returned) AS units_returned
FROM fact_return_line frl
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON frl.product_key = dp.product_key
INNER JOIN ref_fiscal_calendar rfc ON rfc.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND rfc.fiscal_period = 4
WHERE dp.category = 'Garden' 
    AND dp.subcategory = 'Garden Furniture'
    AND frl.return_date >= rfc.period_start_date 
    AND frl.return_date <= rfc.period_end_date

SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS return_line_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT frl.sales_line_id) AS distinct_original_sales,
    COUNT(DISTINCT dp.product_key) AS distinct_products,
    MIN(frl.return_date) AS earliest_return,
    MAX(frl.return_date) AS latest_return
FROM fact_return_line frl
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON frl.product_key = dp.product_key
INNER JOIN ref_fiscal_calendar rfc ON rfc.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND rfc.fiscal_period = 4
WHERE dp.category = 'Garden' 
    AND dp.subcategory = 'Garden Furniture'
    AND frl.return_date >= rfc.period_start_date 
    AND frl.return_date <= rfc.period_end_date

calls.statement:
SELECT 
    quantity_returned,
    COUNT(*) AS count_of_returns
FROM fact_return_line frl
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON frl.product_key = dp.product_key
INNER JOIN ref_fiscal_calendar rfc ON rfc.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND rfc.fiscal_period = 4
WHERE dp.category = 'Garden' 
    AND dp.subcategory = 'Garden Furniture'
    AND frl.return_date >= rfc.period_start_date 
    AND frl.return_date <= rfc.period_end_date
GROUP BY quantity_returned
ORDER BY quantity_returned

SELECT 
    fiscal_year,
    fiscal_period,
    fiscal_period_label,
    period_start_date,
    period_end_date,
    calendar_date
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar rfc
INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON dd.calendar_date = rfc.period_end_date
WHERE dd.calendar_date >= DATE '2026-10-01'
ORDER BY rfc.fiscal_year, rfc.fiscal_period
LIMIT 1
